summary: Best 68.260 (r4b4_c8 eval 13,928M, CP5; incumbent 54.674): warm continuation that went through the CP4 window, the 64-66 s dip, the bowl and on past CP5 / kill floor *31. What did it: (1) --race-kill-aware 1: the plain shaping field routes through kill plates (pays for fatal falls) and gave the bowl's divider window no gradient - ~2B steps stuck at 60.5 (bare, ez bursts) never moved the ceiling; the masked field took the line through in ~730M steps, then a gate per ~50-100M steps (63.5, 64.3, 66.1, 68.3). The warm switch first collapsed the line to 1.9% (the observation features read the same field) and re-learned in ~480M steps. (2) NEW --eval-parallel / --eval-idle-secs: the sequential eval was 45-52% of the wall clock; ~1.5-1.8x training per box-hour, same scores (in the scratch recipe now). (3) unstuck T cap 0.25 -> 0.1 (0.5 collapsed the line). Untested: --respawn-greedy-speed (built for energy gates); decoupling the observation field from a kill-aware shaping field for warm switches.
